newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia, Hong Kong agree to tackle crime together.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia, Hong Kong agree to tackle crime together.

text.p: Australia and Hong Kong on Monday signed an agreement to work together more closely at combatting international organised crime.
"This agreement will provide for a wide range of mutual assistance in the investigation and prosecution of criminal activity, Hong Kong chief secretary Anson Chan told reporters.
Chan joined Australian Attorney General and Minister for Justice Daryl Williams at a signing ceremony to coincide with the opening of a Hong Kong trade mission in Sydney.
"The need for international cooperation in fighting crime has become increasingly apparent," Williams said.
Chan, the head of Hong Kong's 190,000 strong civil service, was scheduled to meet with local politicians, community and business leaders during her week-long visit to Australia.
